title: EarthBound Beginnings
description: EarthBound Beginnings is the localized name of Mother, the 1989 Famicom role-playing game by Ape Inc. and Nintendo that began the Mother/EarthBound series. This SNES romhack recreates Mother 1 on the EarthBound (Mother 2) engine, giving the original adventure of Ninten and his friends 16-bit visuals and music. Players explore a 1980s-style American world, battling enemies and collecting the eight melodies needed to confront the alien force Giegue.
